response.sql:
WITH sex_averages AS (
  SELECT p.SEX, AVG(1.0 * l.CPK / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE l.CPK IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT <> 0
  GROUP BY p.SEX
), first_filter AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(avg_ratio) OVER () AS first_mean
  FROM sex_averages
), second_filter AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(avg_ratio) OVER () AS second_mean
  FROM first_filter
  WHERE avg_ratio > first_mean
)
SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_ratio,
       AVG(avg_ratio - first_mean) AS average_above_first_mean,
       AVG(avg_ratio - second_mean) AS average_above_second_mean
FROM second_filter
WHERE avg_ratio > second_mean;

assumptions.assumption: A missing ratio includes a null CPK or GPT value and a zero GPT denominator; the second mean is the mean of the sex averages that pass the first filter.
